en.title: Netflix Drops October 2026 Slate: Affleck Thriller, Cyberpunk Returns & More
en.summary: Prepare for a stacked October 2026 on Netflix, featuring a star-studded political thriller and a highly anticipated return to the neon-drenched streets of Night City. Get ready to clear your watchlists.
en.body:
Netflix is setting the stage for a blockbuster October 2026, and early indicators point to a slate that will satisfy both movie buffs and dedicated series fans. With Halloween on the horizon, the streamer is rolling out a lineup that includes a tense political thriller, a gritty drama, and the long-awaited return of a beloved anime series.

The cinematic centerpiece for October appears to be **Ben Affleck**'s directorial effort, **Animals**. This political thriller, which also stars **Affleck** alongside **Kerry Washington** and **Gillian Anderson**, is generating significant buzz. The film promises a gripping narrative, and the newly released trailer hints at a tense, high-stakes story that could be a major talking point for the season. Alongside **Animals**, Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy team up for the action-satire **Sacrifice**, adding another dose of star power and genre-bending fun to the movie offerings. For those seeking more grounded storytelling, Tyler Perry's latest drama, **Doing Life**, is also slated for release.

## Night City Beckons and Heists Continue

TV enthusiasts have just as much to anticipate. The critically acclaimed **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** is set to return with a second season, promising another dive into the brutal, vibrant world of Night City. The first season captivated audiences with its stunning animation and compelling story, and the stakes for **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2** are incredibly high to meet fan expectations. Fans of intricate plotting will also rejoice as **Lupin** returns for its fourth part. Omar Sy's charismatic Assane Diop has consistently delivered thrilling cat-and-mouse games, and this latest installment is expected to continue the French heist hit's impressive run. While not explicitly detailed in early announcements, the return of shows like **The Diplomat** for its fourth season also suggests a robust schedule for established fan favorites.

## Awards Buzz and Fan Anticipation

The early October slate also hints at potential awards contenders. Florence Pugh is set to star in **East of Eden**, a limited series that is already being positioned as a major contender for prestige television awards. The ambition and talent involved suggest a deeply resonant and critically lauded project. For fans of **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners**, the anticipation for the second season is palpable. The first season's success created a dedicated fanbase eager for more stories from this unique universe, and the pressure is on for the showrunners to deliver another compelling arc. The combination of original content and returning fan-favorites ensures that Netflix is aiming for a wide audience this October, with something for nearly every taste.

## What's Next

Netflix will continue to update its October 2026 schedule throughout September. Key releases include **Below** on October 8th, **Animals** on October 9th, **Sacrifice** on October 16th, and **Lupin: Part 4** later in the month. Fans should keep an eye out for further announcements regarding additional licensed content and original series.
